column1: # Native PE identity PE:6a70a6d9:02711000; source: ../Dwarf Fortress.exe.
# Static source catalog for all item info-panel title owners. RTTI TypeDescriptor -> signature-1 CompleteObjectLocator -> vtable -> actual +0x5e8 slot -> .text function.

# 98 distinct item RTTI/vtable owners; 15 distinct getDescription functions. Existing data/extracted/map-hover-item-sources.tsv contains 97 owners; the only additional owner is itemst, sharing generic 0x140ca5bb0.
# vtable_va is the vtable base; slot_va is the actual address vtable_va + 0x5e8. Function groups describe shared implementations once; owner rows retain every native dispatch owner.
# Title native route: active_sheet ITEM -> 0x140154924 calls 0x140c65450(item,out,false,-1) -> optional resize 0x1401549a2 and three-dot writes -> draw 0x140154a23.
# 0x1401582c0 is a container contents list draw, not a second main item title. Building-contained item descriptions delegate through the building +0x188 catalog.

# 0x140c65450 supplies artifact/copy/designation/quality/wear/count logic around +0x5e8; detailed literal inventory remains data/extracted/map-hover-item-sources.tsv and data/extracted/corpse-caption-sources.tsv.
# Named artifact path 0x140c654b9..0x140c654e2 tail-jumps to 0x140a94030 and returns before ordinary wrappers. Custom authored strings are preserved.

# Chinese mappings live in data/runtime/rulesets/zh-Hans/items/*.toml, shared RAW/material/creature/text namespaces, data/runtime/item-description-translations.tsv and the typed resolvers named below.

# Whole title translation entry is src/fortress_item_captions.inc::translate_fortress_item_caption; it delegates exact terms, item terms, coin, equipment, written/procedural names, then complete composition.
# Function-group/native-branch rows document native production; they do not assert that dynamic mod/custom text has finite enumerable vocabulary or record runtime observations.
